craft_notes: Sthāyin: bond-burning. Rows: blazing then burning. Read aloud: brand.

lines: Then in one's own right hand, blazing, the god-wheel worshipped,
that hand burning the pupil's bonds on crown-heart-navel, lay down.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ svadakṣiṇahaste dīpyatayā devatācakraṃ pūjayitvā taṃ hastaṃ mūrdhahṛnnābhiṣu śiṣyasya pāśān dahantaṃ nikṣipet
